vocabulary.definition: to create or devise (a story or plan) by careful thought
vocabulary.example: She concocts a plan to surprise her friend on her birthday.

vocabulary.definition: the act of placing someone in a mental hospital or other institution for treatment
vocabulary.example: After experiencing a mental health crisis, he underwent institutionalization for a period of time.

vocabulary.definition: fundamental or extreme; advocating or based on thorough or complete political or social change
vocabulary.example: The group proposed a radical solution to address the environmental crisis.

vocabulary.definition: a spoken or written account of connected events; a story
vocabulary.example: The book intertwines multiple narratives to create a complex and engaging plot.

vocabulary.definition: able to flow easily; not restricted or rigid
vocabulary.example: Her writing style is fluid and captivating, drawing readers into the story effortlessly.

vocabulary.definition: to rise above or go beyond the limits of; to surpass or exceed
vocabulary.example: Their love seemed to transcend all obstacles, making their bond unbreakable.
